title: Triangle inequality for the Gowers norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and $k$ a positive integer, and let $f,g\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. For $h\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, write $\|h\|_{U^k}$ for the $2^k$-th root of $\mathbb E_{x,y_1,\ldots,y_k}\prod_{s\in\mathbb F_2^k}h(x+\sum_{i=1}^k s_i y_i)$, where the average is uniform over all choices in $\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $\|f+g\|_{U^k}\leq \|f\|_{U^k}+\|g\|_{U^k}$.
